Yesss, your new fulltime warehouse job is here! 🥳 Work as a warehouse worker with flexible hours in the bol warehouse! Get a salary of €14,99 per hour. With shift allowances you can even get up to €22,49 per hour! 🤑 Sounds good, right?! Apply now at CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk and start your new job next week already. 🚀

What we offer
- €14,99 gross per hour (21+)
- Allowances of 10%, 25% and even 50%!
- A fun job for 32-40 hours as orderpicker
- You choose which shifts you want to work!
- Get a permanent contract quickly!
- Work with colleagues from all over the world!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse worker:

- You speak Dutch or English
- You have your own transportation to get to Bol
- You can work in Waalwijk

What will you do
Do you love online shopping? 📦 Then you'll definitely love working at bol. The biggest online store in the Netherlands! As a warehouse worker, you make sure every order gets to the right place. From toys to tech and from books to beauty products. Bol has it all!

You collect products in the warehouse and bring them to the packing department. Here everything gets ready for shipment! You'll also get to try out different departments. So you can find the one you like best! Every day is a little different. And that makes it fun, right? And with #blackfriday around the corner, you'll always have something to do! ☺️

You can work in the day or afternoon shift. There are weekend shifts too! Perfect if you want to work some extra hours 💪

Where will you work
You'll work at CEVA Logisticsin Waalwijk for bol, 'de winkel van ons allemaal!' (that means: the shop for all of us). People from all over the world work here. So you'll quickly learn how to say 'hello' in 5 new languages!

And the perks? During peak season you can enjoy a free lunch. And in summer there's free ice cream! 🍦 You'
